note: What each finished fixture actually carries, read back from its own bytes. The finalizer's report says what this build believes it wrote; this says what the paper shows.

artifacts.proofMethod: AcroForm fill: every value is set on the document's own widget and its appearance is generated by the form. The counts below are read back from the finished PDF with pdf-flattened-widgets.mjs, at each field's own measured /Rect.
artifacts.addedGlyphsNote: Non-whitespace glyphs read back from the finished PDF's own flattened widget appearances. This family writes through AcroForm widgets rather than by drawing into page content, so every one of these glyphs is a widget appearance the flatten stamped onto the page. It is not a count of ink outside a widget; that is the column beside this one.
